verdict.rationale: MX publishes an OpenAPI specification (GitHub repo) and tells developers to import it into Postman to explore request and response payloads. Free developer API keys and test institutions make those requests runnable. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-docs API reference with try-it or runnable examples, so exploration depends on an external tool (Postman), and probes found no OpenAPI spec at standard docs paths. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive API reference with in-browser runnable examples, documented code samples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.
